name: orchid-convention
description: Enforces a project's coding conventions while an agent writes code: a stack-agnostic core plus one rule pack per language.

plugins.name: convention-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic machinery: rule schema, guard engine, lint dispatcher and (later) the scan gate. Ships no rules.

plugins.name: convention-swift
plugins.description: Swift 6 and SwiftUI rule pack. Data only; requires convention-core.
